text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for training! All right,
I'm
gonna
give it my all to—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did something move just now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
H-h-how did you get in here?! Please,
just get out
of here as quickly as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. Why aren't you moving? Are you
just a
toy or something? Huh, I guess
there's nothing to
worry ab—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaahhh! You just twitched! You're
real!
Someone save me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... You're right by the door.
I can't
get
out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Please come back soon, Fuku...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to leave her room,
Matikanetannhauser
ends up missing
training.
